title: Forex market definition
claim: Forex is the global currency trading market where foreign exchange transactions occur.

title: Trading with essential funds is dangerous
claim: Never trade money that cannot afford to lose; do not use children's education savings or essential funds for trading.
support: Explicit warning in introductory section
mechanism: Loss of capital can devastate essential expenses and life stability

title: Fundamental analysis for forex
claim: Fundamental analysis examines economic factors, market conditions, and country-specific data to assess currency value.
support: Textual explanation in market analysis chapter

title: Technical analysis tools for forex
claim: Technical analysis uses charts, support/resistance levels, trend lines, and moving averages to identify market patterns.

title: Three-level trend line classification
claim: Trend lines are classified into short-term (15/30-minute charts), medium-term (60-minute), and long-term (4-hour/daily).

source.section: Technical Analysis - Three Trend line Strategy

support: Explicit categorization with chart timeframe examples
mechanism: Longer timeframes filter out noise, reduce whipsaws
failure_modes: Over-reliance on short-term trends that break intraday

title: Emotional trading causes losses
claim: Emotional decision-making in forex trading leads to systematic losses and violations of trading plans.
support: Discussion of discipline and loss management
mechanism: Emotional traders override stop-losses, chase losses, overtrade

title: Forex robots with simulated profits are unreliable
claim: Forex trading robots marketed with simulated/backtest-only performance records do not generalize to live trading.

source.section: Step-by-step Secrets to Win with Forex

support: Author warns that robot sellers use faked track records
mechanism: Backtest overfitting, data snooping, unrealistic assumptions in live markets
assumptions: Simulated results do not survive transaction costs and slippage
failure_modes: Negative live return despite positive backtest
validation: Can be verified by comparing live vs. backtest performance

title: Scalping and day trading are ineffective
claim: Short-term scalping and day trading strategies do not work reliably due to random intraday volatility and fake performance records.

source.section: Step-by-step Secrets to Win with Forex

support: Author asserts scalping/day trading fails due to volatility and faked track records
mechanism: Random intraday noise, excessive transaction costs, timing uncertainty
